subject: Term rollforward & onboarding sync for expansion
messages:
Message 1 of 5
From: Sophie Grant <sophie.grant@helixhealth.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: Helix Procurement <procureops@helixhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + capacity increase / vendor re-onboarding question

Hi Avery,

Hope you're well. We're lining up our Q1 2029 renewals and want to consolidate Redwood onto a refreshed procurement flow. Two asks: 1) Can we extend our current term by 6 months (rollforward) to align with our fiscal year close, and 2) increase committed capacity by ~40% for burst workloads?

Procurement has requested we re-run the vendor onboarding (minor admin refresh) given new internal controls — they want confirmation on data retention, SOC2 evidence, and a short SOW amendment that captures the uplift and revised term.

Can you map the steps we need to complete on your side and confirm if Redwood can accept PO PR-8423 once submitted through the portal? We have a purchase window the week of Nov 6.

Thanks — Sophie
Sophie Grant
Head of Cloud Integrations, Helix Health

---

Message 2 of 5
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Grant <sophie.grant@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Nov 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity increase / vendor re-onboarding question

Hi Sophie — thanks for the note and the clear asks. High level plan below; I'll own coordination with procurement and legal: 

1) Term rollforward: we can do a 6-month amendment to current agreement. Legal needs the target effective date and whether pricing changes are required.
2) Capacity uplift: we can provision a staged 40% committed uplift with a burst buffer; we'll propose a 30/10 staged ramp (30% immediate, additional 10% in 60 days) to avoid quota gating.
3) Vendor onboarding refresh: we only need updated procurement contact + signed AUP/processing addendum. SOC 2 and security questionnaire are already on file; I'll attach the latest evidence bundle.
4) PO acceptance: yes, we can accept PO PR-8423 via the procurement portal; procurement should submit under Redwood vendor code RWI-US-221.

Action items for Helix: provide target effective date for the rollforward and confirm billing code. For our side: Jonas (procureops) will kick the portal intake ticket; Marissa will prepare the SOW amendment for signature and attach to DocuSign.

Proposed timeline:
- Nov 1: Agree on effective date and PO number
- Nov 3–6: Helix submits PO via portal; Redwood pulls procurement ticket
- Nov 7–9: Legal review and DocuSign of SOW amendment
- Nov 10: Capacity ramp begins (30%)

I'll attach the procurement checklist for your ops team and the draft security questionnaire we have on file.

Best,
Avery
Avery Johnson
Account Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: procurement_checklist.xlsx; security-questionnaire.pdf

Thanks — jumping in with procurement ops details. Sophie, quick checklist for the portal intake to avoid delays: 
- Submit PR with PO number and line items mapped to SKU: RWI-CAP-BASE and RWI-CAP-BURST.
- Billing address + remit to: Redwood Inference, 420 Market St, San Francisco, CA
- Provide purchase order PDF (PR-8423) and point-of-contact for invoice approvals.
- Indicate whether you need Net30 or Net45 terms — this affects our billing flow.
- If Helix intends to prepay any portion, mark the deposit line item.

Portal note: we will set the intake as 'renewal-expansion' so it triggers a fast-track review. Please CC procureops@helixhealth.com on the submission and paste our vendor code RWI-US-221 in the portal comments.

I've attached the procurement_checklist.xlsx that mirrors the portal requirements. If legal at Helix wants to redline the SOW amendment directly, send to legal@redwood.com and we'll consolidate.
